summary: The first Mission Rock building: a 23-story, 283-unit rental tower by MVRDV on Parcel A at 3rd Street, with two office floors and ground-floor retail; TCO May 2023, first residents June 1, 2023, opening ceremony June 21, 2023. It also houses the district energy plant that serves the whole neighborhood.

milestones.text: Port Commission approves the Mission Rock DDA, Design Controls and related documents (Resolutions 18-03 to 18-10)
Board of Supervisors affirms the EIR certification and project approvals (Resolution 33-18); Notice of Determination filed March 9, 2018
Development Agreement and Disposition and Development Agreement take effect (DA term 30 years)
Developer submits the Phase 1 Phase Submittal (Parcels A, B, F and G) to the Port
Port Commission approves the $145.4M Phase 1 budget and parks plan (Resolution 19-39)
Port executes the 75-year prepaid Parcel A lease (Lease No. L-16703) with Mission Rock Parcel A Owner, L.L.C.; memorandum recorded October 7, 2020
Vertical construction starts (Swinerton says 'beginning of 2021'; the Port's December 2021 update reports foundation and podium work under way)
Declaration of Restrictions recorded against Parcel A identifying the BMR units in perpetuity
Temporary Certificate of Occupancy issued; construction complete
Opening ceremony with Mayor London Breed
MOHCD lottery for the 102 BMR units draws 2,963 applicants (the Port's October 2023 table gives the lottery date as 6/20/23)
Leasing status: 126 of 181 market-rate units (70%) and 28 of 102 BMR units (27%) leased; all 90% AMI units taken, 120% and 150% AMI units lagging

Port Commission (Resolution 25-17) approves cutting Parcel A's BMR units from 102 to 73 (26%), eliminating the 150% AMI tier and raising 90% AMI units from 10 to 19, subject to Board of Supervisors approval of a Housing Plan amendment lowering the per-phase BMR minimum from 30% to 20%
Site permit 201910073782 for new construction of a 24-story, 283-unit residential building approved
New construction site permit application 201910073782 filed
DBI permit 202409090347 approved: add control dampers on levels 2 and 3, revise smoke control matrix and firefighter smoke control panel
Over-the-counter alteration permit filed for tenant improvements in ground-floor suite C, proposed use food/beverage handling

240 ft (73 m) per MVRDV and the Design Controls' Block A maximum; SF YIMBY reports 258 ft

open_questions: Construction cost of The Canyon: no source found; the Port memos cover only the horizontal (site-level) budget.
Street address: not stated in any primary document read; the repo's status.csv gives 1011-1023 3rd St. Needs a DataSF or Port confirmation.
Whether the Board of Supervisors approved the March 2025 Housing Plan amendment (30% to 20% per phase) and the Parcel A lease amendment: not found on Legistar during this pass.
Groundbreaking date: Wikipedia says December 2020 without a citation; Swinerton says early 2021; no Port document dates it. Kept as approximate 2021.
Height: MVRDV says 240 ft, SF YIMBY 258 ft. A building permit or the Planning design-review record (CPC 2013.0208PHA-02) would settle it.
The repo's status.csv and milestones.csv date the opening ceremony June 24, 2024; the sources say June 21, 2023 (SF YIMBY, MVRDV). Flagged in the PR for the owner.

Images: no 'before' photo is hosted (until 2020 the parcel was the Seawall Lot 337 surface parking lot) and no rendering is hosted because the architects' renderings are not openly licensed; they are reachable through the architect sources listed here.
